sloka: बालवृद्धावशेषां तु लङ्कां कृत्वा शरोर्मिभिः ।रावणं च रिपुं हत्वा सीतां समुपलप्स्यसे ।। ६.५०.५८ ।।।।
transliteration: bālavṛddhāvaśeṣāṁ tu laṅkāṁ kṛtvā śarormibhiḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ ca ripuṁ hatvā sītāṁ samupalapsyase ।। 6.50.58 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lanka will be left with youngsters and the aged with your arrows. The enemy Ravana killed, you will recover Sita."
